reports.text:
This week felt too hard for me. I showed up every day and saved new words, but only 22 of 59 cards went right. Matching was the worst: 10 of 24. Typed meaning was rough too, 4 of 20, because I lose the spelling or the meaning fast. Multiple choice was the only thing that felt fair. Read aloud was shaky, and say translation never worked, 0 of 2. Three times the app didn't hear me, which was annoying.

Some words did come back, like andare, vero, vuoi and devo after 2 days, and stai, casa, dire and others after 1. That helped. But no word repeated within a session, so I never got a second try right away.

What bothers me most is that forse, proprio, credo, cose, quanto and fuori slipped away and no card asked about them. They just vanished.

This week felt too hard. I played all 7 days, one session each, and got only 25 right out of 70 cards. Typed meaning and matching were both 11 right out of 28, and multiple choice was 3 out of 7. Say translation was the worst: 0 out of 7. Two of my spoken answers weren't heard, so I can't tell how much of that was me and how much was the app. Five cards couldn't be matched to a saved word either.

Nothing repeated within a session, so I never felt drilled on one word. Some words did return on later days, like andare after 5 days, and certo, puoi and casa after 4 days.

What bothers me is the words I forgot that no card asked about: forse, proprio, credo, cose, quanto, fuori, parte, qualcuno, ciao, volta, adesso, uomo. I saved 18 new words, but these never came back, so they keep slipping away.

This week felt too hard. I played all seven days, one session each, and got only 20 of 70 cards right. Typing the meaning was rough, 6 of 28, and matching was only a little better at 8 of 28. Multiple choice was the one place I felt okay, 5 of 7. Saying translations was a disaster: 0 of 6. I did get my one read aloud right. One spoken answer was not heard, and 8 cards could not be matched to a saved word, which was annoying.

Nothing repeated inside a session, so no word nagged me. Some did return after a long gap: stai and vita after 12 days, posto after 9. The bigger problem is the words I forgot that never came back: casa, forse, proprio, credo, cose, quanto, fuori, anni, parte, qualcuno, ciao, volta. I saved 16 new words, but I'm forgetting the old ones faster than they return.

This week felt too hard for me. I played every day, but only 25 of 70 cards came out right. Typed meaning and matching were okay-ish, 11 of 28 and 13 of 28. Multiple choice went badly at 1 of 7, and say translation and read aloud were a total miss, 0 of 4 and 0 of 3. Three spoken answers weren't heard, so I can't tell how many of those were really my fault.

No word repeated within a single session, so nothing felt drilled. Old words did come back, like vuoi and casa after 16 days, but by then I'd mostly lost them.

What bugs me are the words I forgot that no card asked about: forse, proprio, credo, cose, quanto, puoi, fuori, parte, qualcuno, ciao, volta, adesso. I saved 12 new words, yet 6 cards couldn't be matched to a saved word. I'd like those forgotten ones to return sooner.

This week felt a bit too hard for me. I played all 7 days, but only 4 of my 10 cards went right. Typed meaning was the worst: I got 1 of 4. Matching was 2 of 4, read aloud 0 of 1, and multiple choice was my one clean win, 1 of 1. I saved 3 new words, which felt fine.

No word came up twice in a session, so nothing felt repetitive. Old words did return, though, like puoi after 14 days and signore after 11. That's a long gap, and I'm not surprised I struggled.

What bothers me is the words I forgot that no card asked: stai, casa, altro, andare, forse, proprio, tempo, credo, vita, cose, quanto, fuori. They just sat there fading.

The app didn't hear 1 of my spoken answers, and 1 card didn't match any saved word.
